
UPDATE-TAG
Update a registered tag description or category

USAGE
  fspec update-tag <tag> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <tag> (required)
    Tag to update

OPTIONS
  --description <description>
    New description
  --category <category>
    New category

EXAMPLES
  1. Update tag description
  $ fspec update-tag @performance --description "High-performance features"
  ✓ Updated tag @performance

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec register-tag
  fspec delete-tag
  fspec list-tags
